scalars.scalar_value: Demonstrated experience performing skilled custodial duties.

items.item_text: Regular work schedule is 10:00pm to 6:30am, Monday through Friday.
Must work occasional flexible, variable hours, including evenings, weekends and holidays as needed.
Must use proper safety gear as necessary.
Must be able to safely lift, move, carry, push and pull a minimum of 75 lbs.
Demonstrated experience performing skilled custodial duties.
Demonstrated experience operating, storing, and maintaining the following equipment: vacuums, buffers, wet/dry vacuums, rotary carpet shampooers, steam extractors, high-pressure washers.
Demonstrated experience in floor care; stripping, waxing, and buffing.
Demonstrated experience in carpet care; spot cleaning, spin bonneting, shampooing, and extracting.
Demonstrated experience securing facilities, including responsibility for keys.

Under the supervision of the Custodial Supervisor the Sr. Custodian is responsible for participating in the overnight cleaning of the Price Center and Student Center facilities managed by University Centers (Campus Student Union).

Sweep, mop, dust, and vacuum indoor and outdoor areas of the facilities. Extract, shampoo, and spin bonnet carpets. Clean and disinfect restrooms, pick up trash, empty trash, operate trash compactor, and other assigned duties related to maintaining the cleanliness of the facilities. Operate vacuum cleaners, buffers, high pressure washers, carpet cleaning machines (spin bonnet, shampoo, extract, pile-lift), wet/dry vacuums, extractors, and floor scrubbing/polishing machines during cleaning, stripping, waxing, buffing and other related cleaning operations.

Submit daily shift summary reports; submit work orders for items needing maintenance or custodial attention. Secure buildings and equipment when not in use. Restock paper, soap and other cleaning supplies.
Perform routine maintenance and repairs of custodial equipment.
Must be able to safely lift, move and carry a minimum load of 75 lbs.
Must be able to safely operate University Centers vehicles (cart, pickup truck, one ton stake-bed truck).
Ability to read and interpret written information and instructions, including daily operations reports which are integral in performing reservable space cleaning.
Ability to communicate effectively both verbally and in writing. Ability to prepare written reports and complete forms.
Demonstrated interpersonal skills to effectively work with a diverse group of students, staff, faculty, and customers.
